column3: The Hebrew names Ammonites again in the final group; BSB names Meunites there.
The Hebrew says Aram; BSB says Edom.
The Hebrew repeats “the LORD” where BSB uses “Him.”
The Hebrew calls Abraham the one who loves You; BSB calls him Your friend.
The Hebrew repeats “this house”; BSB repeats “this temple.”
The Hebrew says the Spirit of the LORD was upon him in the assembly; BSB describes it coming upon him as he stood there.
The Hebrew says “behold, they are coming up”; BSB says “You will see them coming up.”
The Hebrew repeats “the LORD” where BSB uses “Him.”
The Hebrew leaves the subject unnamed and says splendor of holiness without a possessive expression; BSB names Jehoshaphat and adds His.
The Hebrew lists possessions, bodies, and precious objects; BSB describes goods and valuables found on the bodies.
The Hebrew says “they called” the place by that name; BSB uses the passive “is called.”
The Hebrew says they came to the house of the LORD; BSB explicitly describes going into it.
